body:
## Approved Implementation Plan

### Sub-task 1: Add cost fields to backend `JobRun` model [Light]
- Add `total_cost_usd: Option<f64>`, `duration_ms: Option<u64>`, `num_turns: Option<u32>`, `model: Option<String>`, `usage: Option<serde_json::Value>` to `JobRun`
- Use `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if)]` for backward compat
- Update all `JobRun` construction sites in tests
- Files: `acs/src/models/run.rs`

### Sub-task 2: Extract cost data from NDJSON log at run completion [Standard]
- Scan tail of log for `result` and `system` events after run completes
- Populate new `JobRun` fields before saving
- Files: `acs/src/daemon/executor.rs`
- Depends on: ST1

### Sub-task 3: Update OpenAPI spec and frontend types [Light]
- Add cost fields to `JobRun` schema in OpenAPI
- Add fields to frontend `JobRun` interface + add `CompletedWithWarnings` status
- Add `formatCost()` and `formatDuration()` helpers
- Files: `acs/web/openapi.yaml`, `electron/packages/frontend/src/lib/types.ts`, `electron/packages/frontend/src/lib/format.ts`
- Parallel with ST1

### Sub-task 4: Add "Cost" tab to `StreamJsonViewer` [Standard]
- Summary cards (cost, duration, turns), model info, token usage table
- Reads from parsed NDJSON events, fully independent
- Files: `electron/packages/frontend/src/components/StreamJsonViewer.tsx`
- No dependencies

### Sub-task 5: Add cost column to run history table [Light]
- Files: `electron/packages/frontend/src/routes/JobDetailPage.tsx`
- Depends on: ST3

### Sub-task 6: Add cost to run detail status bar [Light]
- Files: `electron/packages/frontend/src/routes/RunLogPage.tsx`
- Depends on: ST3

### Sub-task 7: Historical cost trend chart [Standard, nice-to-have]
- SVG sparkline, no new npm deps
- Files: new `CostTrendChart.tsx` + `JobDetailPage.tsx`
- Depends on: ST5
